ERR_LVGL_NOT_INSTALLED.hint: Install the screen on a display first.

ERR_LVGL_NOT_DISPLAY.message: {id} does not work as a display

ERR_LVGL_NOT_TOUCH.message: {id} does not work as a touch panel
ERR_LVGL_NOT_TOUCH.hint: Choose a touch device, or none.

ERR_LVGL_FORMAT.message: The screen cannot draw the pixel format {format} of {id}

ERR_LVGL_FLUSH_MAX.message: {id} takes at most {flush_max} bytes at once, less than one row ({row})

ERR_LVGL_NO_MEMORY.hint: Free memory: a smaller screen heap or fewer modules.

ERR_LVGL_HEAP.hint: Give the screen a heap within the range.

ERR_LVGL_POOL_FULL.message: The screen's memory is full: {free} free, {need} needed, {reserve} kept in reserve
ERR_LVGL_POOL_FULL.hint: Fewer widgets or shorter texts, or a larger screen heap.
